$comment: Recall suite (docs/runbooks/conversation-lab.md). Driven through the UI by apps/web/e2e/lab/recall.lab.ts as the seeded synthetic founder Maya (QuietQuad), graded by conversation_lab/recall.py. RC-01 is the owner's scenario: a call, hang up, a second call minutes later, 'do you remember what we talked about last time?'. Facts are invented and absent from the seed, so only the earlier conversation can supply them. `gapSeconds` is the pause between the two conversations (LAB_RECALL_GAP_SECONDS, or `run --recall-gap-seconds`, overrides every scenario's). A check passes when at least `minGroups` of its synonym groups are mentioned, including every group listed in `require` (the distinctive fact).

scenarios.title: call, hang up, second call minutes later: do you remember?

lines: Hi! Big news. We just signed a letter of intent with Hartwell University for their two main libraries.
We're thinking of charging them nine hundred dollars a semester per library.
Honestly my biggest worry is their IT team taking forever on single sign-on.
Hey, do you remember what we talked about last time?
And what did I say my biggest worry was?

scenarios.title: chat, then a call: what did I tell you in chat?

lines: Quick update: Devin heard back from the student union. They'll promote QuietQuad if we add group booking for study rooms.
What did I tell you in our chat about the student union?

scenarios.title: a call, then a chat: who did I say is joining?

lines: One more thing before I go. We're bringing on a part-time designer called Noor next month.
Do you remember who I said is joining us?
